title: BYINTEK Love U4, 1080P version (Skyworth board RG_HS352_D1E8_SW_B10, HiSilicon Hi3751V350)
notes:
BYINTEK Love U4, 1080P version (Skyworth board RG_HS352_D1E8_SW_B10, HiSilicon Hi3751V350)
Android 9, firmware 1.01.08 (Hi3751V352F_DMO-userdebug, build 2025-09), 1 GB RAM

Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/byintek-u4/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/byintek-u4/debloat.txt com.zeasn.whale.saas
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.zeasn.whale.saas (Zeasn "Whale"); Android's FallbackHome is the only other HOME.
Keep com.sdt.app.skysettings (all projector settings, input sources, and the ADB switch: see README),
com.sdt.projectionservice (keystone and focus), every com.hisilicon.* package (TV service, HDMI input,
Miracast, media), com.skyworthdigital.*, and the factory test apps, which may hold calibration data.
Keep com.android.toofifi too: it is the AirPlay, Chromecast and DLNA receiver ("tranScreen").
Zeasn ads and store
The ad service is a persistent system app with permission to install apps silently: Android starts it
at boot even when disabled. Hiding it (optional, needs root, see README) is what keeps it from running.
